title: The Broken Landfall
author: E. M. Vane
blurb: Paloma Oyelaran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
